objective: Review a verified historical funnel snapshot in shadow mode and determine whether a controlled experiment is ready for council consideration.
assumptions: the supplied snapshot contains posted or otherwise finalized observations
unknowns: no verified historical revenue dataset is committed to the repository

rollback_plan.trigger: schema failure, evidence conflict, or council hold
rollback_plan.procedure: discard the shadow output and retain the previous approved policy state

success_criteria: proposal is hash-bound to all independent council reviews
no customer contact or money movement occurs
unverified inputs produce HOLD or TEST_ONLY
